AND artifact_id IN ('prefetch', 'amcache', 'registry', 'shimcache') AND ( ( artifact_id = 'prefetch' AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.files_loaded') ILIKE '%\DOWNLOADS\%.EXE%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.files_loaded') ILIKE '%\DESKTOP\%.EXE%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.files_loaded') ILIKE '%\APPDATA\LOCAL\TEMP\%.EXE%' ) ) OR ( artifact_id = 'amcache' AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.IsOsComponent') = 'false' AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\Users\%\Downloads\%.exe' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\Users\%\Desktop\%.exe' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\Users\%\AppData\Local\Temp\%.exe' ) ) OR ( artifact_id = 'registry' AND json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Category') = 'Program Execution' AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ValueData') ILIKE '%\Users\%\Downloads\%.exe' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ValueData') ILIKE '%\Users\%\Desktop\%.exe' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.ValueData') ILIKE '%\Users\%\AppData\Local\Temp\%.exe' ) ) OR ( artifact_id = 'shimcache' AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Path') ILIKE '%\Users\%\Downloads\%.exe' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Path') ILIKE '%\Users\%\Desktop\%.exe' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.Path') ILIKE '%\Users\%\AppData\Local\Temp\%.exe' ) ) )

rule_meta.title: Payload Dropped in a Startup Folder (MFT)

sql: SELECT audit_id, ts_utc, artifact_id, event_type, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') AS full_path, json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FileSize') AS file_size FROM unified_events WHERE case_id = ? AND artifact_id = 'mft' AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\inetpub\wwwroot\%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\wwwroot\%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\htdocs\%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\www\%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\tomcat%\webapps\%' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%\xampp\htdocs\%' ) AND ( json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.aspx' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.asp' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.ashx' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.asmx' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.asax' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.php' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.php3' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.php4' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.php5' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.phtml' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.jsp' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.jspx' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.jspf' OR json_extract_string(payload_json, '$.FullPath') ILIKE '%.cfm' )

rule_meta.title: Server-Side Script Written Into a Web Root (MFT) — Web Shell
